messages:
harper: opening a small PR to add an 'effective_tokens' metric to the billing examples and update the "Tokens & Cost" dashboard panel. want a compact SDK snippet showing X-Cost-Attribution header too.

noel: sounds useful. what's the reasoning for effective_tokens vs raw_tokens? customers ask about punctuation/tokenization distortions.

harper: effective_tokens = billing.normalized_tokens (post-tokenizer adjustments + system prompt attribution). idea: present both metrics and explain why normalized is better for per-request cost heatmaps.

anya: can you include a short example showing how to map responses to cost in the docs? a tiny table or bullet example helps support folks.

harper: added this inline: "Example: request with client_prompt=20, model_prompt=80 -> normalized_tokens=100, unit_cost * 100 = billed tokens cost" and a note about minor variance across tokenizers.

ben: for dashboard, switch panel query to `sum by (tier) (rate(billing.normalized_tokens[5m]))` and change title to "Token burn rate (normalized) by tier". include panel UID G-tokens9 in migration note.

harper: done on branch https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6102. also added cross-ref to pricing FAQ explaining tokenizer differences.

noel: please add a short SDKv4 curl + python snippet that demonstrates the X-Cost-Attribution header format (key:value pairs). e.g., `X-Cost-Attribution: client=frontend,feature=chat` so customers can tag costs.

harper: added snippets. curl example: `curl -H "X-Cost-Attribution: client=mobile,feature=reply" -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"open-7b","input":"..."}'`. python example included and tiny note: header is free-form UTF-8, stripped at 512 chars.

docs-ci-bot: lint and snippet-tests running on PR #6102.

anya: one nit: document retention/PII guidance for X-Cost-Attribution (customers might put user ids). add: "Avoid PII. Use hashed ids or tags."

harper: added PII guidance and a short policy pointer to the privacy page.

docs-ci-bot: snippet-tests passed, linkcheck found one legacy anchor; auto-fixed. all checks green at 3467890145.

noel: thanks. can you add an item to the docs migration checklist to notify bizops teams about the new normalized token metric? they'll need it for cost reports.

harper: done, will post a short note in #billing after site build. closing thread.
